name: Calidad Connect
author: calidadse

sections.description:
Calidad is a Swedish marketing agency. Calidad Connect is for Calidad’s clients: it lets Calidad work on the SEO and content of your WordPress site without anyone copying and pasting.

  • You choose what Calidad may do. When you connect, you tick the areas: SEO fields, page and post texts, images and alt texts, blog posts, structured data (schema), and redirects / sitemap additions / llms.txt. Change the ticks at any time.
  • No user, no password. The plugin does not create a user and does not send any password. It makes a secret key for the site and gives it to Calidad once. Every request from Calidad must be signed with that key, be recent, be used only once, and fall inside the areas you ticked – otherwise the plugin refuses it.
  • Content and SEO only. Calidad can never create or change users, install or change plugins or themes, edit files or code, or change WordPress settings. Texts are filtered like an editor’s (no scripts).
  • Works with your SEO plugin. With Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO the SEO fields are written into their own fields. Without one, Calidad Connect prints the tags itself.
  • Everything is logged and undoable. Settings -> Calidad lists every change with an Undo button.
  • Disconnect any time. One click deletes the key at once.

Calidad Connect needs an agreement with Calidad: it is the connection between your site and Calidad’s service, not a stand-alone SEO tool.

What Calidad can do, area by area

  • SEO fields: SEO title, meta description, canonical address, noindex / nofollow, social (Open Graph) title and description, per page, post or product.
  • Texts: rewrite page and post texts and headings, add or fix internal and external links, add FAQ blocks. A text is only changed if it is still exactly what Calidad last read.
  • Images: alt texts in the media library, and new images for blog posts (only from Calidad’s own address).
  • Blog posts: write, schedule and publish posts, with you as the author.
  • Structured data: JSON-LD for pages and for the site, printed by the plugin.
  • Redirects, sitemap and llms.txt: redirects from broken addresses to pages on your site (only where WordPress would show “not found”), extra addresses in a sitemap the plugin serves, and an llms.txt file the plugin serves. Nothing is written to files or .htaccess.

External services

This plugin connects to Calidad Automation, Calidad’s service at calidad.se, run by Calidad (Sweden). Nothing is sent before an administrator types a code and clicks “Connect to Calidad”.

  • When you connect: the code, the site address and the plugin’s REST address, the new secret key for this site, the areas you ticked, the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, whether WooCommerce is active and the name of the active SEO plugin are sent once to https://calidad.se/calidad-automation/wp-connect.php. Calidad stores the key encrypted and uses it only to sign its requests to your site.
  • While connected: Calidad calls your site’s REST API (namespace calidad-connect/v1) to read public content and make the changes your account at Calidad asks for. The site does not call Calidad.
  • When you disconnect: the key is deleted on your site at once, and the plugin tells Calidad, so Calidad deletes its copy.

The plugin never sends anything about your visitors, customers or orders.

  • Calidad’s privacy policy: https://calidad.se/calidad-automation/integritet.php
  • Calidad’s terms: https://calidad.se/calidad-automation/villkor.php
sections.installation:
1. Install Calidad Connect from Plugins -> Add New (search for “Calidad Connect”) and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings -> Calidad, type the code you got from Calidad, check the ticked areas and click “Connect to Calidad”.
sections.faq:
Do I need to be a client of Calidad?

Yes. The plugin does nothing without a code from Calidad.

Does Calidad get access to my admin?

No. No user is created and no password is shared. Calidad can only use the plugin’s own signed endpoints, for the areas you ticked.

How do I stop Calidad?

Settings -> Calidad -> Disconnect. The key is deleted at once. You can also untick areas, or delete the plugin.

Can I undo a change?

Yes. Every change is listed under Settings -> Calidad with an Undo button. A text that was edited again after Calidad is not overwritten.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings, the key, the change log and the redirects are removed. What Calidad wrote into your pages and SEO fields stays, as it is your site’s content.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • Every request is limited to the areas it needs: reading pages and posts, undo and changes to existing posts check the approved area; private and password-protected items are never shown.
  • Replay protection records each request nonce atomically in the plugin’s own table; changes run one at a time.

3.0.0

  • New connection: no user and no application password any more. A site key and signed requests, limited to the areas the administrator ticks, with replay and clock checks.
  • New areas: page and post texts, image alt texts, structured data, redirects, sitemap additions and llms.txt.
  • All in One SEO support for the SEO fields; canonical and noindex / nofollow.
  • The activity log and Undo are now on the site itself.
  • Translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

2.0.0

  • Connection through an application password (replaced in 3.0.0).
